_comment: Personal need-weighting for the Magic Find 'Bedarf' toggle ([P] in the Magic tab). Each of the eight canonical Bausteine gets a relevance weight: higher = more important to you, 1.0 = neutral, 0 = don't care. These ONLY re-weight the module_breadth dimension (how well a tariff's included Bausteine match what YOU need) — every other scoring dimension and the objective default ranking are untouched. A missing key keeps the neutral 1.0, so a partial file is valid. With all-neutral (1.0) weights the Bedarf toggle ranks identically to the objective view. Tracked, no PII (these are generic legal-area preferences, not personal data). Loaded by scripts/magic.py (load_needs).
